title: Deeper/broader application and viewer route-lineage refresh
scope: Reconcile Zephyr's declared DXF/DWG routes against its build instructions
Screen newly surfaced browser and Qt/OCCT viewers for independent format evidence
Update existing optional 2D-consumer admission rules without changing implementation cadence

method.kind: Read-only review of public repository README, usage, license, and development documentation
method.limitations: Project pages are mutable and no released binary, converter invocation, or parser runtime was bound. Claims identify candidate routes only; they are not runtime results or semantic evidence.

sources.revision: Mutable main README and development guide reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The README describes the DXF module as a Swift port of libdxfrw and its app as 2D. The same README's tech-stack table says ODA CLI bridge for DWG I/O, while its file-I/O section names LibreDWG and ODA File Converter. The development guide says automated setup downloads/builds LibreDWG and manual setup clones it. No exact app artifact or selected runtime backend is bound by these pages.

sources.revision: Mutable main README, usage guide, and repository license page reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The viewer documents a DWG worker using @mlightcad/libredwg-web / LibreDWG WASM and a separate JavaScript DXF route. The CAD Viewer package is AGPL-3.0-only. Public documentation does not establish lossless graph retention, AcDs/SAB owner association, or 3D solid semantics.

The project advertises DWG/DXF viewing and separately lists STEP/IGES/STL 3D viewing, but its build instructions require a downloadable mxcadlib package and prebuilt dependencies. The public page reviewed here does not establish parser source, license, or version for that required library.

assessment.zephyrRule: Supersede an earlier unqualified attribution of the Zephyr DWG route to LibreDWG. Treat it as PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE until the selected application artifact, converter executable, version/hash, arguments, intermediate DXF, and importer are bound. Its DXF parser is a libdxfrw-derived route, not an independent parser vote.
assessment.flyfishRule: Optional browser 2D consumer only. Keep its DWG lane correlated with LibreDWG and its JavaScript DXF loader as a separate candidate requiring a named parser version and field-specific value/disposition checks. Render output is not document-graph or solid evidence.
assessment.mxcadRule: Exclude from open-source codec and independent-semantic evidence until the required mxcadlib implementation and license are reviewable. STEP/IGES/STL viewer behavior cannot qualify DWG/DXF 3DSOLID support.
assessment.fixtureAndCadenceRule: Use only locally authored scratch controls at the existing composed gate. No external drawings, new peer dependencies, test registrations, or per-slice application runs.
